# Compute most common genre per playlist
from collections import Counter

for pl in playlists:
    genres = [song_genres[sid] for sid in pl['song_ids']]
    counter = Counter(genres)
    # Find most common; tie-break by first occurrence in playlist order
    max_count = max(counter.values())
    # Get the first genre in playlist order that has max_count
    most_common = None
    for g in genres:
        if counter[g] == max_count:
            most_common = g
            break
    print(f"Playlist {pl['playlist_id']} ({pl['title']}): genres={genres}, most_common={most_common}")
